# FDG9002

> DO model high-level concepts (physical objects) rather than system-level tasks with aggregate components.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.1.3 Aggregate Component Guidelines.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: whether a component models a high-level concept or a system-level task is a design judgment.

## From the book

For example, the components should model files, directories, and drives, rather than streams, formatters, and comparers.
